context: A design review in four images. The two references are screenshots of an in-app reviewer component. The two candidates show a reviewer overlay restyled to look like it, drawn over nyc-live, a dark 3D map app. Judge only the overlay's look: shapes, layout, typography and colours. Ignore the map behind the overlay and differences in the wording or content of labels.
